Each fixed family's decreasing m-limit is the same function g, zero at q and minus infinity otherwise. With rho(n)=1/n, these constant outer limits approach class zero. Use genuine numerical PSH(theta) through its original single defining decreasing FS net phi_i on actual rational B_i, with c1(B_i) tending to theta. This directed net converges at every point to phi and retains convergence of its actual bundle classes. No nested closure is used.

Choose actual ample H with c1(H)-theta ample. Eventually H-B_i is actual ample. Multiplication by generators of a cleared power of H-B_i realizes the same phi_i as an actual H-section maximum: the canonical logarithmic maximum of a generating family is zero at every analytic point. For nonnegative generic maximum define hat(phi)(v)=inf_{t>0} phi(tv)/t. Infima over t and the defining index commute. For rational FS coefficients lambda_j and x_j=log||s_j||(v), the identity
inf_{r>=0} max_j(x_j+r lambda_j)=max_{w in W} sum_j w_j x_j
holds, where W consists of the vertices of {w>=0, sum w=1, sum w lambda>=0}. These are eligible unit vectors and zero averages of two opposite slopes. A piecewise linear convex minimum at zero, a breakpoint, or infinity supplies the attaining vertex. Extended values follow by replacing x_j with max(x_j,-N) and commuting infima. Rational vertices yield actual monomial sections after clearing denominators. Consequently hat(phi) has a genuine decreasing homogeneous FS net in the same varying actual classes.

For C=phi(v_0) and lambda<C, put h_lambda=hat(phi-lambda). Then phi(v)=sup_{lambda<C}(h_lambda(v)+lambda) at every point. Along a scaling ray, the limit is either identically minus infinity or finite decreasing convex. In the latter case a supporting line at t=1 has slope a<=0 and intercept lambda0<=C. An intercept below C gives equality; an intercept equal to C is lowered by epsilon and epsilon tends to zero. This reconstructs homogeneous decomposition without BJ6.24.

Every big rational L admits actual data on the SAME X. Choose actual ample H and small rational epsilon such that theta-epsilon[H] is pseudoeffective. Approximate this class by an actual effective rational Cartier divisor D closely enough that theta-[D] is ample. This uses the definition of the closed effective cone, finite rational coefficient approximation and smoothness. Define actual A=L-O(D); numerical ampleness makes A ample. Hence L=A+D literally, without Bertini, finite generation, modification or a cardinality restriction. Numerical ampleness is the scoped external algebraic theorem Fujino–Miyamoto, arXiv:2101.00806v1, Theorem1.4; its complete pertinent statement and printed proof are preserved. Fix these data before a target. Write sigma=log||s_D||, Z={sigma=-infinity}, U=Xan minus Z. Forward membership of sigma+PSH(A) follows by multiplying a decreasing finite actual-A FS net by s_D, producing an actual L-section net including its common poles.

For homogeneous h<=sigma, use the reconstructed decreasing homogeneous FS h_i on B_i tending to L. Compact K={sigma=-1} gives eventual h_i<-t for every rational 0<t<1. Its divisorial values equal h-sigma. Both h and sigma+r embed into one actual ample H, so divisorial determination proves h=sigma+r at EVERY point. The quotient is unique.

For arbitrary genuine u<=sigma+C0, its homogeneous components satisfy h_lambda<=sigma by scaling the domination inequality. Divide them as sigma+r_lambda. Their r_lambda+lambda are uniformly bounded by u(v_0). Finite maxima, normalized ample compactness and the usc-obstacle principle give an actual A-psh supremum quotient. Divisorial determination then proves u=sigma+r everywhere. This establishes the ENTIRE dominated cone, including uniquely determined quotient values on Z. For arbitrary u=F_D(psi), let psi_j=max(psi,-j), u_j=max(u,sigma-j), and B_j=U intersect {psi>-j}. For bounded quotients define E_D(u)=(n+1)^-1 sum_{j=0}^n integral Q_Du T_u^j T_sigma^(n-j). The constructed metric products identify this with E_raw,A(Q_Du). Define unbounded energy by reference floors. Thus the ACTUAL E1_D space is F_D(E1(A)), E_D(sigma)=0 and E_D(u+c)=E_D(u)+Vc. Decreasing relative nets have decreasing actual quotients by order reflection and fixed-ample closure. Intrinsic targets have mass V and finite D_D(mu)=sup_{u in E1_D}(E_D(u)-integral Q_Du dmu). This uses the unique quotient determined by the retained reference, including its values on Z. It equals V E_BJ,A^vee(mu/V). Actual-ample G0 makes it equivalent to integrability of EVERY actual relative E1 quotient.
